ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low white-to-black ratio, estimated at approximately 1:8; high-intensity pixels are localized in discrete circular clusters and concentrated at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) base across majority of surface; high-intensity (white) pixels form hundreds of distinct circular rings (mottling) and a small concentrated patch at the median notch vertex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips heavily modified by dense biological colonization.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular high-contrast ring patterns concentrated at the distal regions and trailing boundaries of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular resection/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; dense live barnacle colonization creating jagged, high-relief silhouettes on both distal tips.
